note: Each form of a package compiled and compared with the package compiled from its directory: the bytes in a STORED ZIP (rawZip, the platform's form; reversedZip, entries in the opposite order), InstancePackage.to_zip() (canonicalZip, JSON with sorted members) and the members of every JSON object shuffled (permuted<seed>). All of them must have the same IR and semantic digest. Under the previous toolchain (golden/bim_baseline) 64 packages differed in canonicalZip (docs/qa/IR_NORMALIZATION.md).
